title: PALO: A Polyglot Large Multimodal Model for 5B People

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating vision-language reasoning performance across 10 different languages using a translated version of the LLaVA-Bench dataset, specifically comparing the model's accuracy on high-resource languages (e.g., English, Chinese) versus historically underrepresented low-resource languages (e.g., Arabic, Hindi, Urdu).

Evaluating and correcting translation inaccuracies during dataset creation via a semi-automated pipeline, where native speakers manually identify and fix gender alignment and usage errors introduced by underlying LLMs in gender-specific languages (e.g., Arabic, Spanish, Russian).

Qualitatively assessing the model's generated responses for cultural appropriateness and nuances, such as culture-specific humor, culinary suggestions, and regional context across different target languages.
